mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(discover_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayClueCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 AND clue_status = 'pending_judge') AS pendingClueCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND event_status != 'archived') AS activeEventCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND event_status != 'archived' AND risk_level IN ('major', 'urgent')) AS highRiskEventCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_alert WHERE deleted = 0 AND alert_status = 'pending') AS pendingAlertCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_disposal_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND task_status NOT IN ('completed', 'confirmed') AND due_time IS NOT NULL AND due_time < NOW()) AS overdueDisposalCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_account WHERE deleted = 0 AND account_status = 'active') AS activeAccountCount

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_monitor_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND task_status = 'active') AS activeTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_monitor_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND schedule_enabled = 1 AND task_status = 'active') AS scheduledTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_monitor_result WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayResultCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_alert WHERE deleted = 0 AND alert_source = 'monitor' AND alert_status = 'pending') AS pendingAlertCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_alert WHERE deleted = 0 AND alert_source = 'monitor' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayAlertCount
SELECT COALESCE(risk_level, 'normal') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM campus_event WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(risk_level, 'normal') ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT COALESCE(clue_source, 'unknown') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(clue_source, 'unknown') ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT COALESCE(event_status, 'unknown') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM campus_event WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(event_status, 'unknown') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL day_seq.seq DAY), '%m-%d') AS name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_clue clue WHERE clue.deleted = 0 AND DATE(COALESCE(clue.discover_time, clue.create_time)) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL day_seq.seq DAY)) AS clueCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_alert alert WHERE alert.deleted = 0 AND DATE(alert.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL day_seq.seq DAY)) AS alertCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_detection_hit hit WHERE hit.deleted = 0 AND DATE(hit.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL day_seq.seq DAY)) AS hitCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_event ev WHERE ev.deleted = 0 AND DATE(COALESCE(ev.discover_time, ev.create_time)) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL day_seq.seq DAY)) AS eventCount FROM ( SELECT 6 AS seq UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 0 ) day_seq ORDER BY day_seq.seq DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL day_seq.seq DAY), '%m-%d') AS name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_monitor_result result WHERE result.deleted = 0 AND DATE(result.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL day_seq.seq DAY)) AS monitorResultCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_alert alert WHERE alert.deleted = 0 AND alert.alert_source = 'monitor' AND DATE(alert.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL day_seq.seq DAY)) AS monitorAlertCount FROM ( SELECT 6 AS seq UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 0 ) day_seq ORDER BY day_seq.seq DESC
SELECT COALESCE(risk_level, 'normal') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM campus_alert WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(risk_level, 'normal') ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT COALESCE(risk_level, 'normal') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM campus_detection_hit WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(risk_level, 'normal') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(clue_source, ''), 'unknown') AS name, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level IS NULL OR risk_level = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'concern' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concernCount, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'major' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS majorCount, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'urgent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS urgentCount FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(clue_source, ''), 'unknown') ORDER BY totalCount DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT COALESCE(source_platform, '其它') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY source_platform ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(topic_category, ''), 'other') AS name, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level IS NULL OR risk_level = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'concern' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concernCount, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'major' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS majorCount, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'urgent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS urgentCount FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(topic_category, ''), 'other') ORDER BY totalCount DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_disposal_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND task_status NOT IN ('completed', 'confirmed') AND due_time IS NOT NULL AND due_time < NOW()) AS overdueTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_disposal_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND task_status NOT IN ('completed', 'confirmed') AND due_time IS NOT NULL AND due_time >= NOW() AND due_time < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) AS dueSoonTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND event_status = 'reviewed') AS reviewedEventCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND event_status = 'archived' AND DATE(update_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayArchivedEventCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM campus_alert WHERE deleted = 0 AND alert_status = 'pending') AS pendingAlertCount
